remarks: Welcome to Clocktower Close! Sophisticated living is possible. This beautiful 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath loft is more than meets the eye. Kitchen with updated stainless steel appliances. Large living and dining room combination. Head upstairs to a large bedroom with walk-in-closet and full bathroom. Have access to everything this beautiful historical building like the park-like courtyard with outdoor clubhouse, state of the art Gym, large club room with kitchenette, computer room, billiards/ping-pong, Multiple Laundry Rooms. Unit comes with 2 parking passes. Excellent Credit is a must, 2 Month of Security Deposit, Liability/Renters Insurance. AVAILABLE JAN 2, 2026
